text: A galloping steed does not halt its hooves.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: When momentum is on your side, surge right ahead! Don't slam on the brakes!

text: You never know what is long and what is short until you measure them side by side.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Don't chicken out before you even start. You've got to clash to know who wins!

text: There is no mirror without a speck of dust.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Don't exhaust yourself chasing absolute perfection. Being a little crooked is still plenty awesome!

text: Meat must be chewed to taste its flavor, and words must be spoken to have their effect.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Don't bottle it up in your chest and suffer. Speak your mind clearly and freely!

text: The slow, steady steps of an ox carry it ten thousand leagues.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Drop the tricky shortcuts; walk steadily and persistently forward like an ox.

text: When things reach an extremity, they change; through change, they find a way out; through finding a way, they endure.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Only when backed into a corner does the true might of my club awaken!

text: All things come to those who wait.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Plant your seat firmly and hold on a bit longer; a jackpot gift is on its way!

text: A rolling stone gathers no moss.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Keep your body in motion! Stagnant water rots, but a sprinting runner shines bright!

text: Watch like a tiger and walk like an ox.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Keep eyes keen like a prowling tiger, and footsteps steady like a mighty ox!

text: The early bird catches the worm.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Whoever wakes as the morning dokkaebi-fire flares up gets to bag the sack of gold!

text: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Treasure the one who stands by you in hard times as a priceless gem for life.

text: A tower built with sincere devotion does not easily crumble.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Mastery built with painstaking devotion will never topple, even in the wildest storm!

text: Find one fault in others, and you possess ten yourself.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Instead of wasting time faulting others, polish your own club's grip once more.

text: Love your enemies; it is the most supreme revenge you can exact.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Don't burn energy on spite. Shrug it off with ease and channel everything into your success!

text: Water that is too pure has no fish.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Don't be excessively rigid. Being generous and easygoing attracts both friends and fortune!

text: To go beyond is as wrong as to fall short.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Don't get greedy and overstuff yourself. Filling up just to the point of delight is true wisdom!

text: Even if you wring the rooster's neck, dawn still comes.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: No matter what hindrance stands in your path, your bright morning will arrive without fail!

text: Learning has no end.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: No spirit alive can ever best a person who learns something new every single day!

text: He who opens the door of his heart wins the whole world.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Swing your closed heart wide open with this golden key, and the entire realm is yours!

text: Do unto others as you would have them do unto you.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Take the lead in giving, and your golden fortune pouch will return doubled and overflowing!

text: No blossom stays red for ten days.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Neither sorrow nor glory endures forever. Live this present day with quiet resolve!

text: Everything will eventually return to the rightful path.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: No need to feel wronged. Truth will always rise right to the surface like oil on water!

text: Clear the ditch and catch the crayfish.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Whenever you make your move, catch both hares at the same time!

text: Tap even a stone bridge before crossing.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Tap-tap it soundly with my club first, and you will never plunge into deep water!

text: Spitting while lying down only falls back onto your own face.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Slandering others only smears muck on your own forehead. Speak only praise!

text: Fortune comes to those who smile.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Flash a wide, roaring grin! A pouch of good fortune will roll right to your feet!

text: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: I'm standing right behind you holding my club on guard!

text: He who paves his own path turns a rugged thornfield into a road of silk.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Just whack those briars away forcefully with my club and forge your own path!

text: Who never ate his bread in sorrow knows not the heavenly powers.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Even those bitter memories of sorrow will return as sweet golden loaves of bread.

text: The wise do not lose an opportunity, and the brave do not hesitate.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: When opportunity strikes, raise that club high and plunge right in!

text: Deep waters run silent.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Don't make a fuss; quietly build your inner strength. True masters are always serene!

text: The door of fortune opens by pushing, not by pulling.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Hurl your whole body forward! Don't pull—push through with all your might!

text: Forget the past, live fully in the present, and leave the future to destiny.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Dust off what's behind you and focus on the clear cup of water in front of you today!

text: Harmony abides in a household that endures a hundred times.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: When rage flares up, tuck that club away and laugh it off just once.

text: He who underestimates his own strength can never attain victory.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: You've got the guts to shake the whole wide world. Hold your head high!

text: The spring breeze embraces all living things without discrimination.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Warm up your heart generously, and all kinds of good fortune will come tumbling in.

text: Obsessing over petty scratches will never win you the great war.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Stopping just because of a scraped knee? Brush it off and march forward!

text: He who does not laugh today will not be able to laugh tomorrow.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Turn up the corners of your lips right now, and the pouch of fortune will pop open!

text: The tragedy of life doesn't lie in not reaching your goal. The tragedy lies in having no goal to reach.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Even if it's small, plant a vibrant flag that sets your heartbeat racing!

text: He that ruleth his spirit is better than he that taketh a city.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: When a fire erupts inside, take a deep breath—in and out—and you conquer the world.

text: A river that ceases to flow inevitably turns stagnant.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Keep both body and mind stirring, even a tiny bit every single day!

text: Upon the portal of success, the word 'Push' is written.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Don't fidget around outside; throw your whole weight and barge right in!

text: An eagle that fears the wind can never soar into the high heavens.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Spread your wings wide and ride right on top of that raging headwind!

text: The best remedy for anxiety is to lose oneself completely in work.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: When idle thoughts pop up, plunge into your work as if swinging that mighty club!

text: A real friend is one who walks in when the rest of the world walks out.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Treasure the genuine souls who stay firmly by your side as priceless gems.

text: When anger rises, think of the consequences.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Shattering things in a fit of rage costs blood and tears to fix. Stay cool!

text: Wisdom is not a product of schooling but of the lifelong attempt to acquire it.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Even the quiet, plain routine of today nourishes your soul and turns into pure strength.

text: In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Inside that tangled knot of problems hides a shimmering golden treasure chest!

text: A smile costs nothing, but it creates much.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: A bright smile is the ultimate charm that summons sheer fortune without spending a penny!

text: A small kindness can set the greatest change in motion.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Make someone feel delighted today and the entire world lights up.

text: He has not lived in vain who in the morning has heard the Way, and died at evening.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: If you harvest one rock-solid enlightenment today, your day is a roaring success!

text: For actually the earth had no roads to begin with, but when many men pass one way, a road is made.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Stop staring at other folks' footprints. Wherever you set foot, that becomes the road!

text: A straight path never appears crooked.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Walk with fair and square honor, and no evil spirit will dare lay a finger on you.

text: By failing to prepare, you are preparing to fail.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Fasten that club strap tight. The prepared one takes the crown!

text: Cherish this single day, for it will never return again.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Every slipping second is precious! Let's play and work with fiery joy!

text: The most peaceful moment arrives when one lets go of desire.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Unclench those tight fists; both the breeze and the warm sunlight will be caught in your palm.

text: Little strokes fell great oaks.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Never give up; deliver one heavy, grounded strike every single day!

text: Great things are not done by impulse, but by a series of small things brought together.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: One brushstroke and one line of code unite together to create a true masterpiece.

text: Forgiveness is the noblest form of revenge.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Shake off lingering grudges in your heart. Your soul will instantly feel light as air!

text: He who conquers himself wins the whole world.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Smash that temptation to be lazy first!

text: When it is dark enough, you can see the stars.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Going through hardships right now is a clear sign that you are about to sparkle like a diamond star!

text: Envy is the most sincere form of recognition that you are doing well.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Someone feeling jealous of you? Snort at them and surge forward even higher!

text: He who shines from within will never lose his way in the pitch-black dark.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Stoke the dokkaebi-fire in your heart and let it roar blazing bright!

text: He who knows when he has enough is rich forever.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Cherish and enjoy what you have; that itself is a golden palace!

text: Seeking only easy paths weakens the limbs and dulls the spirit.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Charging up steep trails once in a while is how real muscle and grit are forged!

text: Before you speak, let your words pass through three gates: Is it true? Is it necessary? Is it kind?
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: A carefully chosen word works better than the finest tonic.

text: At the very edge of despair, the shoots of hope sprout forth.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: When there's nowhere lower to sink, soaring straight up is the only thing left!

text: Your attitude today determines your altitude tomorrow.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Beam a cheery grin and square those shoulders wide!

text: A river never flows backward against its course.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Stop clutching at bygone days; stride majestically into what lies ahead.

text: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Keep your lips sealed tight and prove yourself through cold, hard results. That's real class!

text: Sincerity and diligence form the mightiest magic wand of all.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Showing up steadily day after day is the ultimate miracle!

text: To subdue the enemy without fighting is the acme of skill.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Overwhelm the opponent with dignity and composed grace instead of crude muscle flexes!

text: A happy person is grateful for what he has, while an unhappy person laments what he lacks.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Start by appreciating that golden key in your hand, and blessings will multiply!

text: Every day may not be good, but there's something good in every day.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Recall just one single pleasant thing from today!

text: One person with a belief is equal to a force of ninety-nine who have only interests.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: With your stubborn conviction alone, you could hoist up a mountain with ease!

text: Steel grows harder the more it is hammered, and man deepens the more trials he undergoes.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: A lump of iron pounded relentlessly with a heavy club is precisely what turns into a legendary blade!

text: He who is contented with little is the richest of all.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Be grateful for the half-piece of red bean rice cake in your hand, and a golden cauldron will roll into your lap.

text: Step back a single pace, and a sky broad as the ocean unfolds before your eyes.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Take just one step backward, and that blocking wall will instantly open wide to reveal the horizon!

text: Courage is going from failure to failure without losing enthusiasm.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Even if your knees knock together, clutch that club firmly and charge ahead!

text: The wise are frugal with their speech and let actions speak.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: The one who lands a quiet, solid strike beats out the smooth talker any day.

text: Expecting a harvest without sowing seeds is nothing but empty vanity.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Spill a single drop of honest sweat today, and your treasure vault will spill over tomorrow!

text: The mind itself is the Buddha; the mind itself is heaven.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Ignite a clean dokkaebi-fire in your core and smile; right here is paradise.

text: Before blaming others, hold up a mirror to yourself.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Blaming others only nicks your club, let's fix our own posture first!

text: If you have given your all today, lie down in peaceful rest.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Put down the club and tuck yourself in, you were absolute fire today!

text: He who lives without hope can never taste victory.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Grip the golden key tight and fan the spark of hope in your chest!

text: Only when the wind and rain pass does a rainbow paint the sky.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Don't pout over getting caught in a little shower, the rainbow is lining up!

text: Wisdom without patience is like a bird without wings.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Plant your seat firmly and hold on just a bit, you will soar when the time comes!

text: Small drops of sincerity gather to become a lantern illuminating ten thousand leagues.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: A single warm glance shared today brightly shatters the dark.

text: He who fears adversity cannot taste true glory.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Raise that club proud and plunge right into the raging waves!

text: Empty greed and wisdom fills; clear the mind and blessings enter.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Shake off that armful of hollow greed, so the golden fortune bag has room to land!

text: He who cannot stand on his own cannot lift another up.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Plant both feet and stand resolute as a boulder!

text: Do not lament over passing time; seize this very moment.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Carpe diem! Let's devour today with absolute relish!

text: A kind heart is a pure spring that puts out any fire in the world.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Drop the venom and reach out with a gentle heart, everything will unravel smoothly.

text: To a mind made up, impossibility is merely an excuse.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Once you slam that club down, don't look back—charge straight ahead!

text: He who brings joy to others finds immense joy within himself.

kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Dust off that bitter lump in your chest; your spirit will float light as a feather!

text: He who can laugh in the face of misfortune is the real conqueror.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Hit with a massive headache? Bust out a thunderous belly laugh like a goblin chief!

text: Our remedies oft in ourselves do lie which we ascribe to heaven.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: You've got to hit the sprint with your own feet first so I can push you from behind with my club!

text: The superior man is modest in his speech, but exceeds in his actions.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Cut the lip-flapping and show it through hard results; that's real goblin loyalty!

text: Just as a tiny spark can set an entire mountain ablaze, a small kindness can transform the world.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: A single warm greeting tossed out today will light up the whole world brightly.

text: Success consists of going from failure to failure without loss of enthusiasm.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Club snapped? Carve a brand new one and swing with all your might again!

text: Envy is the highest tribute that mediocrity pays to genius.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Folks getting jealous? Just laugh it off—it means you're flying way too high!

text: When the heart remains unperturbed, no gale can shake its resolve.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: An unshakeable mind! Stand grounded like an iron rock, even if a typhoon roars!

text: To him who treasures today, tomorrow repays with pure gold.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Use every single minute and second of today like gold; tomorrow you hit the mother lode!

text: He who cannot guard a secret cannot achieve great undertakings.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Keep your lips clamped tight; zip it shut until the master plan succeeds!

text: Humility breeds respect; pride brings about ruin.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Stop strutting and lower your head a notch; that's how you earn the respect of a true boss.

text: The darker the night, the fiercer the goblin-fire blazes.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Pitch-black all around? Stoke the goblin flame in your heart and let it roar blazing red!

text: He who knows how to forgive is the one who is truly invincible.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Nursing grudges only burns your own gut; brush it off like the big-hearted warrior you are!

text: Hope is like a path on the countryside; there never was a path, but when many walk on it, a path comes into being.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Don't care about what onlookers think; stamp your first bold footprint down right here!

text: True friendship reveals its authentic worth in times of adversity.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Grab the hand of the friend who pats your shoulder in tough moments and never let go.

text: He who knows contentment will suffer no disgrace throughout his life.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: When you're deeply satisfied with your own fortune, no one on earth can shake you.

text: Opportunity is not something you merely seek; it is seized by those who have prepared themselves.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Grip that golden key firmly and keep your eyes peeled; dive straight in the second the gate clicks!

text: Wisely and slow; they stumble that run fast.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Don't let your wild eagerness trip you up; march forward with the steady steps of an ox.

text: The wise know their own measure; the foolish spend their lives envying others.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Don't drool over someone else's giant rice cake; the honey treat in your own hand is top tier!

text: This too shall pass, and a day of serenity will unfailingly arrive.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: All of this will blow over too! Lock your fingers on that club and hang in there a little longer!

text: When you make a mistake, do not be afraid to correct it openly.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Got a weak spot? Own up to it coolly and fix it right up; that's true swag!

text: Laughter is the angel's wing that sets the soul dancing.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Giggle and cackle with delight; even this goblin will bust into a merry dance right beside you!

text: If the mind is serene, even a rough mat feels like a cradle of pure silk.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Brush off the worries and stretch right out; this spot right here is absolute paradise!

text: Courage is holding on to faith in a ray of light even in the darkest moment.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Pierce through the gloom with sharp goblin eyes and find the shimmering gold in the shadows!

text: Put warmth and sincere devotion into every single word you speak.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: A single word filled with tender warmth melts right through a frozen chest.

text: A life lived without shame before oneself is the greatest shield of all.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Live with an unblemished conscience, and no enchanted arrow can ever pierce you!

text: The supreme good is like water; it flows around obstructions and fills the hollows before surging onward.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Bumping into a barrier? Just slip right around it; flow smooth and flexible!

text: A tiny seed of sincere devotion summons a colossal miracle.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: The heartfelt care you pour out today will crash down tomorrow as a golden lightning strike of luck!

text: The wise unearth deep wisdom in trials; the foolish do nothing but mourn their lot.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Instead of whining over bad breaks, pick up that club and dig up the treasure chest!

text: Only when walking through the pitch-black night does one learn to navigate by the stars.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Feeling lost? Look up at the night sky; your lucky star has officially risen!

text: He who knows how to love himself can pour love onto others.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Pat your own back with a thunderous thud; you are an absolute rockstar!

text: All great achievements originated from the small resolution of a single soul.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Made up your mind for real? Then every goblin in the universe will push you forward!

text: The wise inspect their own flaws before casting blame on others.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Blaming others just tires your mouth; let's spend that breath polishing this club blade!

text: As a tiny spark burns down a vast forest, a single surge of passion moves the entire world.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Stoke the goblin fire in your chest! The whole realm will melt before your fiery heat!

text: A smile blooming out of hardship shines with the greatest brilliance.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: The tougher it gets, the wider you grin; bags of good fortune will roll right into your lap!

text: He who walks the upright path casts a straight shadow and keeps an untroubled mind.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Walk with honor, and the goblin fire will light your road ahead as clear as midday!

text: Difficulties strengthen the mind, as labor does the body.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: The more you get hammered like raw iron, the tougher you turn into a golden iron club!

text: One kind word can melt away a thousand debts.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Toss out a single warm word; even the thickest sheet of frozen ice thaws in a flash.

text: Time past never returns, like an arrow once shot from the bow; hold no regrets for what is gone.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Dust off the past completely and swing the club in your hands with all your might right now!

text: A broad mind embraces the whole world, while a narrow mind cannot even hold a needle.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Puff out your chest with fearless goblin grit! The whole wide realm fits right in your embrace.

text: The footsteps of one who walks with steadfast diligence are never in vain.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: With every single stride you take today, golden seeds are planting deep into the dirt!

text: Only those who rise above fear greet the light of dawn.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Don't sit shivering in the dark; grip that club tight and charge right forward!

text: The freest life is one entirely unperturbed by the gaze of others.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Who cares if folks whisper behind your back? Dance wild to your own beat!

text: Small acts of consideration cultivate profound trust.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Hand a cup of warm coffee to your teammate today; golden friendship will blossom in no time!

text: He who endures with patience can navigate through any tempestuous sea.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Duck down low while the big waves crash; once the wind softens, it's full throttle ahead!

text: When the mind is tranquil, even coarse fare tastes as sweet as honey.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Kicking back with your legs stretched out to chew sweet rice cakes is the best feeling in the world.

text: Greater in battle than the man who would conquer a thousand-thousand men, is he who would conquer just one—himself.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Take that craving to laze under the blankets and smash it to pieces with your club first!

text: Flowing water never advances without first filling every hollow in its path.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Pack your fundamental skills to the brim; that's how you surge out into the roaring ocean!

text: Laughter is the stoutest armor and the keenest weapon.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Laugh it off with a booming chuckle; every petty squabble will bounce right off you!

text: The wise know when to bide their time, and the courageous never let the moment slip away.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: The moment you smell your shot, bring that club crashing down like a bolt of lightning!

text: All rivers flow toward the sea and never cease their journey.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: No matter how many twists and detours you take, you'll reach the grand ocean of your dreams!

text: If you have lived this day without regret, stretch out your legs and fall into deep slumber.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Set your club aside and rest easy; you scored a solid two hundred out of a hundred today!

text: Subdue your rage, and myriad calamities will naturally recede.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Clamp down on that surging fury; keeping your cool is the ultimate lucky charm!

text: A single step fueled by conviction cuts a journey of a thousand leagues in half.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Believe with your whole soul that our golden key will open the door, and it will!

text: Humility is not lowering oneself, but the virtue of elevating others.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Lift up your companions with praise, and your own stature will soar right along with them!

text: Even a rugged boulder transforms into radiant jade when ground and polished with care.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Every bit of nagging and sweat you weathered today is the chisel carving you into fine jade!

text: Harboring hatred toward another is like pouring venom into one's own soul.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Wipe that hateful person clean from your memory, and pour all your energy into filling your bag of gold!

text: Kites rise highest against the wind, not with it.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: When the headwind howls, thrust that club into the air and launch yourself into the skies!

text: Small drops of sincerity gather to work miracles that can move Mount Tai.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Every single drop of sweat you poured today will crash down tomorrow as a golden lightning strike of success!

text: To him who embraces this day with love, the world stands ever open.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Take a massive gulp of that fresh morning air and kick off the day in high spirits!

text: The wise think thrice before speaking, and look twice before acting.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Measure the angles with eagle eyes before swinging that club to hit a perfect bullseye!

text: When the mind is pure, it blossoms untainted like a lotus flower from murky waters.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: No matter how chaotic the world gets, keep your inner spirit crystal clean and nothing can touch you!

text: Adversity has the effect of eliciting talents which in prosperous circumstances would have lain dormant.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: It takes an epic crisis for the true, unstoppable goblin strength within you to erupt!

text: When you genuinely celebrate the triumph of others, your own victory draws near.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Clap loudly when you see someone else thrive, and a trail of good fortune will head straight for you!

text: He who treasures every moment amasses a fortune more precious than gold.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Catch every second ticking away on the clock like snatching up shiny gold coins!

text: The mouth that guards its secrets is the most impenetrable fortress of all.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Keep a tight lid on your lips; stay quiet and lay low until your winning blow lands!

text: The very ground upon which you stumble and fall is the ground from which you rise again.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Hit rock bottom? Perfect, that means you have a solid floor to spring right back up from!

text: To him who sings of joy, the entire universe answers in harmony.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Hum a catchy tune and swing into a lively club dance; it's an absolute blast!

text: When the mind is restless, steady yourself with deep, measured breathing.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Inhale and exhale three deep breaths; even the most chaotic gremlins will pack their bags!

text: When total sincerity is poured into even the smallest deed, heaven itself is moved.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Tend to this minor task with all your heart, and fortune's gate will swing wide open.

text: Only when the night sky turns pitch-black can we behold the sheer magnificence of the Milky Way.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Things feel pitch dark right now only because the stage is being set for your golden galaxy to blaze!

text: True courage is holding fast to the thread of hope throughout every ordeal.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Grip the rope tied to my golden key and pull with all your might; I won't let you slip!

text: He who learns to listen before speaking is truly wise.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Prick up those ears and listen closely; a flood of invaluable wisdom is pouring out!

text: When the mind is peaceful and still, the world's roughest storms turn into a serene lake.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Stay unshakeable; once the waters of your heart grow quiet, the howling winds settle down too.

text: A single bead of honest sweat shed today carves out the glory of tomorrow.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Those sweat droplets sparkling on your forehead are real golden jewels!

text: The harder the times, the squarer your shoulders should be as you walk with pride.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Don't hang your head; square those shoulders wide! You are the invincible goblin captain!

text: A rain of sweet blossoms showers upon the path of one who walks with hope.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Shake that golden fortune pouch as you march; a grand highway of flowers is rolling out for you!

text: The sleep of a labouring man is sweet, and he who tastes deep peace at the close of day is the true victor.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: You swung that club with legendary style today! Rest easy and recharge!

text: Honesty is the best policy, the most dependable capital, and the strongest shield.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Live with your head held high and your conscience clean, and that club will gleam with blinding gold!

text: A fool's wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: When your blood boils, lower your club and shut your eyes; that's the secret to walking away unscathed!

text: Falling is no disgrace, but refusing to rise again is a true shame.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Push off the dirt, dust yourself clean, and vault straight into the sky with raw goblin power!

text: When the mind is peaceful, even a tiny thatched hut turns into a celestial palace.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Stretch out your legs and snooze without a single care in the world; this place right here is the goblin palace!

text: A single act of gentle kindness can calm a turbulent sea.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Offer a warm, caring look; even the frostiest, most hardened heart will thaw into water.

text: A tree whose roots never dry up sprouts emerald green foliage year after year.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Plant your core skills deep into the bedrock; the moment spring wind blows, you'll burst into full bloom!

text: Fear is nothing more than a hollow, formless shadow.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Don't wet your boots in terror; shine the goblin-fire on it and you'll see it's just a silly phantom!

text: The honest sweat you spill today becomes tomorrow's most invaluable gem.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Those beads of sweat glistening across your brow are pure golden diamonds!

text: He who generously covers the faults of others gathers the loyalty of the entire realm.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Laugh it off like the grand chieftain you are; your loyal crew will flock to you like gathering clouds!

text: Laughter is the wonder drug that creates the greatest miracles at the smallest price.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Grab your belly and laugh until you cry; all foul specters will bolt, and pure fortune will pour in!

text: Only the fish that swims against the current can leap over the roaring waterfall.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Brave the fierce headwind, grip your club tight, and leap high! The carp will turn into a dragon!

text: The wise draw immense lessons even from the smallest occurrences.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Every minor stumble is just a grindstone polishing that club of yours!

text: When the mind is tranquil, coarse garments feel like smoothest silk.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: True riches mean feeling peaceful inside. Loosen up your shoulders and live carefree!

text: Opportunity always places a golden key into the hands of the prepared.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Keep shining that key in your pocket, ready to plunge right in the second the door opens!

text: Let not the sun go down upon your wrath.

text: Even someone far away still stands in their place inside your heart.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: You keep that place. No one can erase it carelessly.

text: Wounds need time to heal. Rushing time only deepens the scar.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: It is fine to do nothing today. Resting is also healing.

text: At the unexpected, the heart stops first. Breathe, then take a single step.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: A paused heart is fine. It is just a comma before beating again.

text: Love lingers more in small habits than grand scenes. Like a hand closing the door for you.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Will you make one small kindness today? That is what lasts.

text: Seasons return even after farewells. You, too, will return to yourself, little by little.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Let us eat one good meal today. That is where recovery begins.

text: Longing does not measure the distance between two people; it measures the depth of the heart.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: As deep as it is, that is how well you loved. That is something to be proud of.

text: Even on a day you did nothing, your heart endured hard. Do not belittle that day.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Enduring is also an achievement. Tonight, that is enough.

text: What went wrong is faster to realign than to undo. Today is a day for realigning.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Let us fix one thing. Fixing one brings the rest along.

text: Those who have laughed together are bound to meet again, even after goodbye.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Think of the laughter you shared. It means the road is still open.

text: Sorrow grows when there is no one to share it. So today, tell anyone at all.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: If you want to talk, talk to me. I am a good listener.

text: Memories are not for holding onto; an album you open now and then is enough.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Open just one page today. Tomorrow's you can see the rest.

text: Those who say goodbye well do not drag regrets; they simply recall them less often.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: It is not forgetting, but hurting less. That is tenderness.

text: After a great shock, small routines become medicine. Food, water, sleep — those three come first.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Start with a glass of water today. When the body recovers first, the heart follows.

text: Confessing is not a matter of courage, but of being ready to respect the other.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: If you are ready, you may say it today. If not, tomorrow is fine.

text: Even a night of crying yourself to sleep is a little lighter by morning.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Sleep well tonight. Tomorrow's you will be a little lighter.

text: Saying I miss you is not weak; it is proof that affection is still alive.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Let that feeling be. A living heart grows again someday.

text: There is no perfectly organized sorrow. It is fine to live with it a little messy.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: You can live even without tidying it up. That is what being human is.

text: When you meet something unexplainable, you need someone beside you more than an explanation.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Today I will simply stay quietly beside you. Words can wait until tomorrow.

text: Old love is closer to warmth than to flame. It stays warm long without being hot.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Today, count the warmth beside you. There is more than you think.

text: Sorrow calms a little once you name it. What is the name of your sorrow today?
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: It is fine if you cannot name it. Knowing it is there is enough.

text: On heavy-hearted days you may postpone decisions. Decisions made heavy linger painfully.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Let us not decide today. Tomorrow's you will choose more lightly.

text: You do not have to hate the one who left. Hatred holds you longer than it holds them.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Instead of hate, keep a distance. That is how you protect yourself.

text: The longer a night alone, the more welcome the sound of morning. Tonight will pass too.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: However long the night, it ends. I will count the dawn for you.

text: If you look at old photos long enough, the you of back then comforts the you of now.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: The you of back then is still cheering for you. You can believe that.

text: Having someone you want to meet again means your heart is still warm.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Let us treasure that warmth. Someday you will need it.

text: Longing is a quiet promise not to forget. It holds even unspoken.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: A promise can be kept unspoken. I am the one who watches over that.

text: Time does not erase everything. It only cools it to a temperature you can handle.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Once a hot memory cools, you can look at it longer.

text: If your body freezes at news, move your toes first. The heart follows.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: One step is enough. That is where recovery begins.

text: Looking at big and small things together makes them scarier. Look at just the one thing now.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Choose just one. Tomorrow's you will choose the rest.

text: Love drifts away when you try hard to be reassured. It comes close when you simply stay.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Today, stay instead of seeking proof. That is the bigger word.

text: Thank you is the quietest form of love. Say it just once today.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Say it to someone close first. You will grow startlingly closer.

text: Eating together is small, yet it is a big act of sharing each other's day.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: If you share a meal today, give that time fully.

text: Love is not filling each other's gaps, but enduring those gaps together.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Gaps need not be filled. Together, they become bearable.

text: The way to love long is simple: see today's them differently from yesterday's.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Discover one new thing today. That is the secret to lasting.

text: A liking heart shrinks when hidden and grows little by little when expressed.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: One small expression is enough. Send a smile today?

text: A fluttering heart is not a wrong heart. It is just a heart still preparing.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Preparing is fine. You can say it whenever.

text: The flutter before a confession is a gift in itself. Enjoy it today.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: It is fine not to say it. Today's fluttering is enough.

text: If a new acquaintance makes your heart flutter, it signals a new season.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: You may welcome a new season slowly. No need to hurry.

text: Sharing fluttering makes it twice as big. Write that feeling somewhere today.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Write it down. Later, the warmth of that day will remain.

text: Some sorrow does not weep. Resting the body loosens that kind of sorrow.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Let us lie down early tonight. When the body rests, the heart loosens.

text: On days you do not want your crying heard, open the window. The wind keeps secrets.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Leave it to the wind. I will not tell anyone either.

text: Loss is not long wailing, but slowly accepting.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Accept just one piece today. The rest can go slowly.

text: The task left to those who remain is to live on. That is different from forgetting.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Living on is not betrayal. They would want that too.

text: Before sudden change, do not grip your plans. The tighter you hold, the more your hands hurt.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Open your hands. You did not lose it; you emptied them.

text: Being told to overcome sorrow is wrong. Learn to live alongside it instead.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: You do not have to overcome it. Keep it beside you and live.

text: Finding one thing to be grateful for inside sorrow raises your heart's temperature a little.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Find just one today. Even a tiny one is fine.

text: Say aloud the name of the one you miss. Your heart eases a little.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Say it once, quietly. I will only listen.

text: Today's small start becomes tomorrow's big change. Beginnings are always quiet.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Start just one thing today. Small, but a real start.

text: It is not too late is not comfort but fact. The door is open again today.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Try once more. Today's door is not closed yet.

text: Time is long for one who waits, but the moment of meeting erases every count.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Waiting is a kind of preparation. Prepare one more step today.

text: Those who enjoy small joys greatly stay happy longer.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Laugh big at one small joy you met today.

text: Laughter is contagious. Making someone laugh doubles your own day.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Make one person laugh today. That laughter returns to you.

text: There is a time to laugh and a time to weep. The hour of weeping does its own work.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Today is for weeping. Tomorrow a time to laugh will come.

text: Your mind is yours; outer events are not. What shakes is usually outside.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Even when the outside shakes, let your center be your own.

text: Adversity is the teacher that forges a person. Today's hardship shapes tomorrow's vessel.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Your vessel is growing larger now. Of course it takes time.

text: Endure, and a good day surely comes. Endurance grows by repeating days.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Endure just today. Those days stack into strength.

text: In a field watered by tears, seeds of joy grow.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Today's tears watered the field. You can see the seeds tomorrow.

text: Happiness comes when you live for others. Living only for yourself makes you shrink.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Do one small thing for someone today.

text: When you cannot tell whether the butterfly dreams you or you dream it, longing turns dreamlike and beautiful.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Today you may long dreamlike. Being beautiful is enough.

text: There comes a moment when someone you trusted looks like a stranger. They did not change; a face you had not seen in a long time simply showed itself.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Do not be startled. That face was part of them too.

text: Nothing vanishes overnight. What looks gone had been quietly collapsing for a long time.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: The collapse was not sudden. So it is not your fault either.

text: There is an emptiness that follows good news. A heart that waited too long finds even joy unfamiliar.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: You may wonder why you cannot just be glad. That feeling is normal too.

text: Where a plan collapses, a person's real skill shows. Soothing your startled heart is skill as well.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Today is for regrouping. Soothe the startled heart first.

text: A familiar road can suddenly feel strange. The world did not change; you grew.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Feeling unfamiliar means you have grown wider.

text: When an unexpected failure comes, the body stiffens first. Three breaths then change your next judgment.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Three breaths — remember only that. What comes next is the next problem.

text: Before big news you may feel nothing at all. Your heart has simply shut itself off for a while.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Feeling numb is fine. The heart will switch on slowly later.

text: What was certain until yesterday wavers today. Certainty was always borrowed for a while.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Wavering is not collapsing. You can set it up again.

text: Seeing another face of someone close feels like betrayal. But people were always beings with many faces.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: It may be a discovery rather than betrayal. Let us judge slowly.

text: Before a halted world people do two things: cry, or drink water. Let us start with the second.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: A glass of water is the start of the next step.

text: One piece of news can flip a day. On such days, postponing decisions is wisdom.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Let us not decide today. The world turns tomorrow too.

text: Shock arrives through the body. When shoulders stiffen and breath shortens, that is the heart's signal.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Drop your shoulders once. That is the first treatment.

text: Joy is completed when there is someone to share it. Laughing alone is half a joy.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: If something good happens today, tell one person first.

text: Good things are enjoyed twice when written down. Let us note today's laughter in one line.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: One line is enough. Later, that line will make you smile.

text: Those who celebrate small wins loudly last long. Celebrate today's work yourself.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Well done. Today, that alone is well done.

text: Joy needs practice too. Those who laugh often bear sorrow better as well.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Laugh big once today. That becomes tomorrow's strength.

text: Homes where laughter is heard last long. Let us make that sound once today.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: One small joke is enough. Laughter is contagious.

text: Good things happen more often to those who believe good things will come.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Hold one expectation today. That opens the door.

text: Recall just three good moments of today. Sleep becomes easier.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Just three. Those three close the day.

text: Joy grows when spoken aloud. Let us say it out loud once today.
author: भूतको ज्ञान डायरी
kkaebi_comment: भूतको सन्देश: Say it out loud: wonderful! The world will brighten a little.
